what_it_sends: Real-time setups from non-approved models, labelled RESEARCH OBSERVATION: NOT A QUALIFIED TRADING SIGNAL; no entry/stop/target.
recommended_scope_reason: Unscoped, all 14 research models would send about 6 observations/day, mostly from rejected (Category D) models; the six Trend Reclaim variants overlap 73-95%.
commands: set TRADEDEN_RESEARCH_OBSERVATIONS_TELEGRAM_ENABLED=1 in backend/.env and restart the engine
